descriptions: Define a Baroid Coriolis density measurement at the active pit inlet, including temperature and pressure references, moving average transformations, and Gaussian uncertainty.

Define a derived mass density measurement using a vibrating tube Coriolis principle, located hydraulically at the active pit and associated with the inlet branch. Specify that the device is provided by Baroid, the signal is transmitted via top side telemetry, and it includes Gaussian uncertainty. Additionally, define derived temperature and pressure measurements at the same location with moving average transformations, setting them as the respective temperature and pressure references for the density measurement.

descriptions: Configure a Baroid-provided flow curve measurement at the active pit inlet, referenced by local temperature and pressure.

Define a dynamic drilling signal for flow curve data measured by a Baroid device at the active pit using the concentric cylinders principle and transmitted via topside telemetry. The measurement is associated with the inlet hydraulic branch at the top of string, undergoes moving average transformation, and uses derived temperature and pressure measurements from the same location as references.

descriptions: Define a continuous plastic viscosity signal for the active pit, computed via a Bingham plastic model using concentric cylinder principles and transmitted via topside telemetry.

Create a continuous dynamic drilling viscosity data point for the active pit, located at the inlet hydraulic branch, which uses the concentric cylinders measurement principle and is computed by a Bingham plastic model fitter subsystem of the Baroid measurement device, while referencing local temperature and pressure measurements, applying moving average transformation, specifying Gaussian uncertainty, and transmitting via topside telemetry.

descriptions: Configure a Baroid-provided Bingham plastic yield point measurement for the active pit fluid, referenced to local temperature and pressure, and transmitted via topside telemetry.

Define a computed fluid shear stress data point representing the Bingham plastic yield point at the active pit, using a concentric cylinders measurement principle and a Bingham plastic model fitter. Associate the measurement with the inlet hydraulic branch, apply moving average transformations and Gaussian uncertainty to the signal, and link it to derived temperature and pressure measurements from the same location as references, with Baroid as the provider and topside telemetry for transmission.

descriptions: Configure a Baroid-provided yield stress data point for the active pit, referencing local temperature and pressure measurements and transmitted via topside telemetry.

Define a continuous computed yield stress data point based on a yield power law model using concentric cylinders measurement principles, located hydraulically at the active pit and associated with the inlet hydraulic branch. The signal, provided by Baroid and transmitted via topside telemetry, must reference locally measured temperature and pressure values, apply moving average transformations, and include Gaussian uncertainty defined by its mean.

descriptions: Configure a Baroid dynamic signal for yield power law consistency index at the active pit, computed via concentric cylinder measurement and transmitted via topside telemetry.

Define a dynamic drilling signal for fluid shear stress representing the yield power law consistency index, provided by Baroid and located at the active pit. The signal is computed by a model fitter using the concentric cylinders measurement principle, referenced by local temperature and pressure measurements, smoothed with a moving average, assigned Gaussian uncertainty, associated with the inlet hydraulic branch, and transmitted via topside telemetry.

descriptions: Configure a dynamic yield power law flow behavior index signal at the active pit, computed by Baroid instrumentation and transmitted via topside telemetry.

Define a dynamic drilling signal for the yield power law flow behavior index as a dimensionless quantity located at the active pit and associated with the inlet hydraulic branch. The signal is computed by a Baroid model fitter using the concentric cylinders measurement principle, with Gaussian uncertainty, temperature and pressure references from the active pit, and a moving average transformation, provided by Baroid instrumentation and transmitted via topside telemetry.

descriptions: Configure a Baroid vibrating tube Coriolis density measurement at the active pit inlet with temperature and pressure references.

Define a dynamic mass density signal measured by a Baroid vibrating tube Coriolis flowmeter located at the active pit inlet hydraulic branch, transmitted via topside telemetry, with moving average transformation and Gaussian uncertainty, using local temperature and pressure measurements as references.

descriptions: Configure a Baroid flow curve measurement in the active pit using concentric cylinders principle, referencing local temperature and pressure, with moving average smoothing and topside telemetry transmission.

Define a direct volumetric flow rate measurement in the active pit using Baroid instrumentation and the concentric cylinders principle, associated with the inlet hydraulic branch. Specify direct measurements for drilling fluid temperature and pressure at the same location, linking them as references to the flow curve. Apply moving average transformations to the raw flow, temperature, and pressure data, and transmit the resulting flow signal via topside telemetry.

descriptions: Configure a Baroid dynamic plastic viscosity signal at the active pit using Bingham plastic modeling and concentric cylinder measurement, referenced by local temperature and pressure.

Define a dynamic drilling signal for plastic viscosity at the active pit, computed by a Bingham plastic model fitter as a subsystem of a Baroid measurement device using concentric cylinders. The signal must be associated with the inlet hydraulic branch, transmitted via top side telemetry, and characterized by Gaussian uncertainty with a mean equal to the signal value. Include continuous data types for measured temperature and pressure at the active pit, apply moving average transformations to all three signals, and link the plastic viscosity calculation to the measured temperature and pressure references.

descriptions: Define a dynamic fluid shear stress signal for the active pit inlet, computed via Bingham plastic modeling and transmitted via top-side telemetry.

Configure a dynamic fluid shear stress signal located at the active pit, using concentric cylinders measurement principles and a Bingham plastic model fitter to determine the yield point. The signal should be associated with the inlet hydraulic branch, referenced against measured temperature and pressure from the active pit, processed with a moving average, characterized by Gaussian uncertainty, and transmitted via top-side telemetry by Baroid.

descriptions: Configure a Baroid yield power law yield stress signal at the active pit using concentric cylinder measurements with temperature and pressure references.

Define a dynamic yield stress signal for a yield power law fluid at the active pit, computed by a model fitter on a Baroid concentric cylinder measurement device. The signal must use the device's measured temperature and pressure as references, apply a moving average transformation, include Gaussian uncertainty centered on the signal value, associate with the inlet hydraulic branch, and transmit via topside telemetry.

descriptions: Define a Baroid-provided yield power law flow behavior index signal at the active pit, computed via concentric cylinder rheology and transmitted via topside telemetry.

Establish a dynamic dimensionless flow behavior index signal for a yield power law model at the active pit, derived from a Baroid instrument using a concentric cylinders measurement principle and a dedicated model fitter. The signal, associated with the inlet hydraulic branch and referenced by local temperature and pressure measurements, includes moving average transformation, Gaussian uncertainty, and is transmitted via topside telemetry.

descriptions: Define continuous and peak axial acceleration measurements at the bit hydraulic assembly, provided by Halliburton and transmitted via mud pulse telemetry.

Establish dynamic drilling signals and continuous derived measurements for both peak and continuous axial acceleration at the bit hydraulic assembly, using an axial reference frame and Halliburton as the provider. Apply a moving maximum transformation to the peak signal, associate Gaussian uncertainty with its mean, and transmit the peak measurement via mud pulse telemetry.

descriptions: Configure a dynamic differential pressure rate of change limit at the positive displacement motor for the auto driller to ensure stable drilling.

Define a dynamic drilling signal for the rate of change of differential pressure located hydraulically at the positive displacement motor, provided by the advanced drilling control system standard interface, and set as a maximum limit for the auto driller controller to support stable drilling objectives. Additionally, define a continuous data point for the recommended maximum differential pressure, provided by the D-WIS advice composer and sent to the advanced drilling control system standard interface, using the rate of change signal as its maximum limit.

descriptions: Configure the auto driller controller with a maximum volumetric flow rate of change limit at the bottom of the string and a recommended maximum flow rate from D-WIS.

Define a dynamic signal for the maximum volumetric flow rate of change at the bottom of the string, provided by the advanced drilling control system interface, and assign it as the hard limit for the auto driller controller which targets stable drilling, flow rate, and rotational velocity objectives. Additionally, configure a recommended maximum volumetric flow rate provided by the D-WIS advice composer as the soft limit for the auto driller, ensuring this recommendation respects the maximum flow rate of change constraint.

descriptions: Configure the auto driller to use a recommended bottom-of-string rotational velocity set point from the D-WIS advice composer, constrained by a maximum angular acceleration limit provided by the advanced drilling control system interface.

Define a continuous recommended target for angular velocity at the bottom of the string, provided by the D-WIS advice composer as set point advice for the auto driller controller to achieve stable rotational velocity, and transmit this set point to the advanced drilling control system interface. Simultaneously, define a continuous dynamic signal for angular acceleration at the bottom of the string, provided by the advanced drilling control system interface as the maximum limit for both the auto driller controller and the recommended angular velocity set point, linking this limit to the stable rotational velocity objective.

descriptions: Configure a drilling signal for overpressure fault detection and recovery recommended parameters, provided by an advisor accounting for pack-off, fracturing, and drilling features, and transmitted to the advanced drilling control system.

Define a drilling signal carrying dynamic recommended parameters for an overpressure fault detection, isolation, and recovery function that implements a pressure limit and addresses pack-off, loss circulation, and stuck pipe incidents. Specify that an advisor provides these parameters to the advanced drilling control system standard interface, while accounting for pack-off, formation fracturing, lookup table, circulation, cuttings transport, downhole pressure, drilling fluid displacement, drilling fluid sweep, on-bottom drilling, and rig action plan features.

Establish a dynamic return flow capacity scale provided by a pit volume estimator to serve as the gain for a conversion transformation that scales the return flow proportion, representing a volumetric drilling flow rate.

descriptions: Configure the D-WIS service to provide downhole equivalent circulation density at the BHA annulus, derived from downhole pressure, top liquid level depth, and reference pressure.

Define continuous measurements for downhole pressure and equivalent circulation density at the BHA annulus, applying moving average transformations to both signals. Configure a pressure-to-equivalent-density transformation that uses the downhole pressure, top liquid level true vertical depth, and top liquid level absolute reference pressure as inputs, where the liquid level measurements observe the air-drilling fluid interface under circulating conditions. Assign drilling fluid and air as the fluid types at the BHA annulus, define the vertical depth frame for the liquid level, and link the resulting equivalent circulation density signal to the D-WIS internal service provider.

descriptions: Define a direct drilling pressure measurement at the swivel with Gaussian uncertainty, provided by Petromar and transmitted via topside telemetry.

Configure a continuous direct measurement of drilling pressure located at the swivel logical element and associated with the inlet hydraulic branch upstream of the top-of-string junction. The measurement is taken by a hydraulic device connected to the swivel, provided by Petromar, transmitted via topside telemetry, and characterized by Gaussian uncertainty where the mean equals the measured value and the standard deviation is derived from a separate signal.

descriptions: Define a direct tangential acceleration measurement at the swivel sub provided by Petromar, transmitted via topside telemetry with Gaussian uncertainty.

Establish a continuous direct measurement of tangential drilling acceleration located mechanically at the swivel sub and physically at the rotating drive system, provided by Petromar and transmitted via topside telemetry. Assign Gaussian uncertainty to this measurement, linking its mean to the acceleration value and its standard deviation to a dedicated drilling data point for the standard deviation of tangential acceleration.
